# Introduction

## Learning Objectives
After this presentation, attendees will be able to employ an advanced assessment of student learning outcomes methodology to develop leadership skills at their institution.


# Overview

## Motivation

- Foster students' leadership skills in complex business environment and needs (Comprehensive knowledge, critical thinking skill, problem solving skill, etc.)
- Needs assessment methods to achieve such a complexity
- Maintain the feedback process between assessment and curriculum development in a timely, yet sustainable manner


## Resources and Constraints

- Abundance of data; but
- Lack in structure


## Challenges
1. Need an effective methods to
    - assess learning outcomes and
    - improve curriculum.
2. Need a sustainable implementation for such a method.


## Solutions
1. Multi-layered Assessment
2. Curriculum Improvement from Assessment Outcomes
3. Semi-automated Data Processing


# Step 1: Design & Course Implimentation

## Learning Objectives & Assessment Tools
Establish learning objectives & assessment tools for

- Core Courses
- Programs (i.e. Concentration and Major/Minor)

Each objective has both

- External Assessment Tools
- Internal Assessment Tools and

## Standardized Objectives

- Annual strategy meeting
    - SMART objectives
    - Alignment with the program goals
- Signature Assignments
    - Highly standardized assignments (questions, instructions, rubrics, etc.)
    - While leaving rooms for flexibility in the rest of each course
    - Clear association with the course learning objectives

## Complementary Design
- External Assessment Tools for
    - Lower-level Learning
    - Comprehensiveness in Contents
    - Calibration of Assessment Levels
- Internal Assessment Tools for
    - Higher-level Learning
    - Comprehensiveness in Modes
    - Application and Critical Thinking


## Standardized Exam
Case: [Peregrine Exam](https://www.peregrineacademics.com/) category scores

- Collect scores at the aggregate as well as category level
- Used for external assessments


## Standardized Rubrics

- Disaggregated rows
- Explicit correspondence to assessment

## Example

### Business Core 8

Learning Objective: Evaluate socio-cultural and international diversity variables in decision making.

- External Tool: Peregrine CPC Exam
    - Use the total score of the "Management: Human Resource Management" category.
    - Measure the share of students who meet the goal (i.e. US average score).
    - Aims for 70% of students meeting the goal.
- Internal Tool: Project Assignment "Ethics Case"
    - Use three rubric rows marked with PLO8a, PLO8b, PLO8c.
    - Measure the share of students who meet the goal (i.e. achievement level 3-5 out of 5 levels).
    - Aims for 70% of students meeting the goal.
    
### Implementation

A simple look-up table of objectives and assessment tools.

- Broadly shared
- Easily updated and maintained
- Ready for programming and reporting

![Look-up table of assessments](fig/lookup.png)

# Step 2: Data Collection & Analysis

## Rubrics in Leraning Management System
Case: [D2L](https://www.d2l.com/) rubrics

- Collect assessment outcomes at the individual row level
- Supplementary data collection
    - Course and assignment matched with D2L rubric IDs
    - Instructors' impression and analysis collected
- Used for internal assessments


## Complementary Design in Action
Challenge: Internal and external assessment outcomes are not directly comparable

- Track the changes over time
- Two-dimensional dynamics
- Possible calibration


## Data Processing

### Challenges

- Inconsistency in rubrics (e.g. word choices, typos, etc.)
- Variations in the data sources (e.g. external/internal, rubric/exam, etc.)
- Timely responses for feedback

### Solutions

- Literal programming for reproducible analysis
- Iterative data processing

## Example

### Management 1 & 2

Time plot shows the dynamics of assessment outcomes over academic years.

![Management 1 time plot](fig/mgt1-timeplot.png)

Scatter plots make it easier to interpret the dynamics of internal and external assessment outcomes *jointly*.

![Magement scatter plot](fig/mgt-scatterplot.png)


# Step 3: Feedback & Strategy Development

## Annual Meeting & Strategy Development

- Data analysis provided
- Discuss the findings with additional qualitative information from discutants
- Review the existing assessment tools in light of learning objectives
- Propose changes in assessment tools (and/or learning objectives)


## Continuous Feedback

- Assessment Committee
- Curriculum Development Committee
- Individual faculty members (both regular and temporary)
